title: Company setup and canonical state dump

findings.name: installer UI
findings.detail: R1 on a real host is the operator opening the install link and running the product installer. That package is not in the pinned tree (PACKAGE-PENDING); this rehearsal drives the fixture `setup.mjs`, which stands the company up through the product's own modules. Named stand-in: the first-run UI, not the company state.

notes: Seeded past as stored: 104 tickets, 133 replies, 428 audit rows, 9 fleet devices, 6 ReviewDesk ledgers, 3 stack tool trees.

The canonical dump is written under this step dir as `state-dump.json` (315 KB) with its digest in `state-dump-summary.json`; both passes must reproduce it byte-identically, which the R7 pass diff re-checks.
